Title: UmbraDesktop Media Add-on
Description: Your media library, managed the way you manage files on your own computer: folders in as many windows as you like, dragging between them, copy and paste, and undo.

AuthorDetails.Name: Luuk Peters
AuthorDetails.Description: Umbraco developer building packages that extend the CMS with enterprise-grade features.

RelatedPackages.Description: The desktop itself. This package is an add-on to it and installs it as a dependency; the desktop works on its own without the Media Manager.
The small tools for the desktop, Notepad and Paint among them. Independent of this package: install either, both or neither.

Screenshots.Caption: A Media Manager window on the People folder, with an image open beside it in Umbraco's own editor and its card ringed, under the Umbraco theme.
